propositions: Jira rebar-id label is written before local CREATE event and binding are durably published; final push rejection on ephemeral runners loses local state while label persists, stranding unbound_jira drift permanently
L10 guard skips adopt replay when rebar-id label is present, and binding-store recovery only walks pending entries (which were lost), preventing automatic healing

Recovery extension detects marked-but-unstored keys (label equals deterministic inbound local id, no binding-store entry, no local ticket) and replays adopt through existing inbound-create leaf instead of standing down
Replay adopt route is idempotent: routes through existing _apply_inbound_create dedup guard, retired-skip gate, and label write-back without introducing L11 double-bind risk
Foreign markers, multi-marker keys, keys with live store entries, and keys with local tickets continue to stand down unconditionally; fsck audit untouched and continues alerting until binding exists
